CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_workflow_version_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'WorkflowVersion is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
END;
$function$
